subject: general
question: Who was the first Portuguese explorer to reach India in 1498, arriving at Calicut on the Malabar Coast?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Vasco da Gama**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vasco da Gama** was the first Portuguese explorer to reach **India** in **1498**, landing at **Calicut on the Malabar Coast**.
 
• This expedition marked the beginning of the **European Age of Exploration** and established a direct sea route between Europe and India.
 
• His journey was a key event in the history of **global trade**, as it opened the way for the spice trade and other goods between Europe and Asia.
 
• The expedition of Vasco da Gama was sponsored by **King Manuel I of Portugal**.
 
• Vasco da Gama set sail from **Lisbon** in 1497, rounded the **Cape of Good Hope**, and reached the Indian Ocean.
 
• Upon his arrival in Calicut, he was welcomed by the ruler, the **Samudri Raja (Zamorin)**, which paved the way for future Portuguese dominance in Indian trade.
 
• This voyage is considered one of the most significant achievements in the history of navigation and trade expansion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Columbus**__

 __
 
• **Christopher Columbus** was an Italian explorer who set out to find a westward route to Asia but instead discovered the **Americas** in 1492.
 
• He made four voyages across the **Atlantic Ocean** under the sponsorship of the Spanish monarchs, King Ferdinand and Queen Isabella.
 
• Columbus never reached India; his voyages led to the discovery of the New World.
 
 
 
• **Nino-da-Cunha**__
 __
 
• **Nuno da Cunha** was a Portuguese governor of India from **1529 to 1538**.
 
• He is known for transferring the Portuguese capital in India from **Cochin to Goa**.
 
• He played a significant role in expanding Portuguese influence in India but was not the first to reach India.
 
 
 
• **Albuquerque**__
 
 
• **Afonso de Albuquerque** was a prominent Portuguese general and statesman in India, serving as the second Governor of Portuguese India from **1509 to 1515**.
 
• He is known for capturing **Goa** in 1510 and laying the foundations of Portuguese colonial rule in India.
 
• Though a key figure in Portuguese expansion in India, he was not the first Portuguese to arrive in the country.
